title: The Sweet Postcard
author: Ivo Brightwater
blurb: Paloma Oyelaran, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
